title: Page2AI Benchmark: reproducible web-to-Markdown extraction comparison
description: An open, reproducible benchmark that compares Page2AI, Firecrawl v2, and Jina Reader on documentation frameworks (Mintlify, Docusaurus, Starlight, Nextra, Fumadocs). Includes automatic scorers for chars, headings, code blocks, tables, and empty-alt image ratio. Framed as an exploratory case study, not a statistical benchmark.
notes: By Igor Saevets. Central author page: https://igorsaevets.github.io/page2ai-docs/about/
